summary: The evaluation clock elision test runs as two tests, one per fixture (a single untimed step, and 20 steps with timeouts), so they run in parallel: its wall time is about 20 s instead of about 27 s on a build host, with the same checks.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to run both fixtures in one test again.
